text:
Devon: quick async pulse from me — what I did: merged the route-mapper PR (https://git.company/infra/route-mapper/pull/512), added a fallback policy for unknown-tenant -> route to default-ingress. Ran smoke canary on staging.
Lin: reviewed the PR earlier, left one minor comment about the header normalization. overall LGTM. :thumbsup:
Raj: saw a small spike of 429s against /v1/infer in prod around 09:06 UTC, looks correlated with a burst of 20k ephemeral tokens. digging logs now.
sre-bot: incident-digest: spike detected on prod /v1/infer at 2026-02-12T09:06Z, 5m error rate +3.2x. Pager on-call: @Amir
Amir: taking it. preliminary: spike came from a single client IP range, probable retry storm. Throttling rule for that route temporarily tightened at 09:12 UTC.
Maria: blocker for me — private key rotation for jwt-kid is blocked until KMS grant is applied for the deploy service account. @security any ETA? cc @Devon
Devon: noted, filing a quick infra request. Meanwhile I pushed a small config so canary falls back to the older jwt verifier when kid missing. short-term mitigation.
Lin: question — for the new route policy, do we prefer prefix-match or regex for partner routes? regex gives flexibility but slightly slower. I'm leaning prefix for performance.
Devon: prefer prefix for hot paths. for partners that need pattern matching we'll add an indexed regex table behind feature flag.
Raj: quick debug snippet I ran:
```
# show recent 5xx/429 counts per route
jq -r '.routes[] | select(.errors>0) | "{route}:" + (.errors|tostring)' /tmp/route-metrics.json | sort -r
```
It showed /v1/infer ~ 98 429s in the 5m window — reduced after Amir tightened throttle.
Amir: follow-ups: (1) I'll open a short-runbook entry for retry storms on infer routes; (2) can we add a lightweight token-bucket on edge for high-cardinality clients? pinging product for sizing.
sre-bot: deploy 2026-02-12T09:12Z: route-mapper v5.2 rolled to staging (canary 10%) — no errors.
Maria: thanks. once security confirms KMS grant I'll attempt key rotation on staging then prod tomorrow AM.
Devon: today's plan: merge normalization comment (Lin), watch canary for 2 hours, then promote. Also review Amir's runbook PR when ready.
Lin: I'll pick up the normalization patch and a tiny perf test for prefix vs regex on routing table.
Raj: will follow up with the 429 root cause after I finish log slice (posting results here). no other blockers from infra side.
Maria: quick FYI: prepping a short demo for PMs on Dedicated pool throttling controls later today, will ask for a short handoff if anyone's free at 16:30 PST.
Devon: great — I can join for 10 mins. otherwise all good from my side. :white_check_mark:
